meta.description: Set up LinkedIn Ads measurement, attribution, KPIs, and conversion tracking. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn ads attribution, conversion tracking, LinkedIn Insight Tag, campaign KPIs, LinkedIn ads ROI, pipeline attribution, self-reported attribution, or how to measure LinkedIn Ads success. Triggers on "LinkedIn attribution", "conversion tracking", "Insight Tag", "campaign KPIs", "LinkedIn ROI", "pipeline attribution", "measure LinkedIn ads", "LinkedIn CAPI", "self-reported attribution". Do NOT use for bidding/budget (use bidding) or campaign structure (use campaign-setup).
